name: Die Grünen – Die Grüne Alternative
detail: Die Grünen in Austria campaign under 'Superreiche fair besteuern' exclusively for an inheritance tax on Millionenerbschaften (starting at 1m EUR), not an annual net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Werner Kogler
detail: Former Vice-Chancellor and federal spokesperson of Die Grünen; explicitly advocates only taxes on Millionenerbschaften (inheritance), not an annual net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.
